new_inventory_entry.name: BINARY_PAIR_UPWARD_EQUALITY_CSP_CARRIER
new_inventory_entry.mechanism: A future state is carried by finite local domains over constant-size pair states together with constant-arity clause relations that factor exactly into unary pair-state restrictions and coordinatewise upward relations over equality bits. Global feasibility is decided by the coordinatewise maximal realizable equality vector.
exact_preconditions: Each global boundary variable has a polynomially representable constant-size local state domain.
Every local factor has a proved exact decomposition R=(product of unary local domains) intersect eq^{-1}(M).
Local internal reconstruction witnesses are independent once shared boundary states are fixed.
Successful updates preserve/rebuild the same factor form in polynomial time.
new_inventory_entry.solver: Intersect unary local domains per global variable. If any domain is empty, UNSAT. Set each equality bit to 1 whenever an equal local state remains available, otherwise 0. Test every upward factor on this maximal vector. If all pass, choose compatible local states independently and reconstruct local witnesses.
new_inventory_entry.complexity: Polynomial in explicit factor/incidence size; no enumeration of global combinations is required.

calibration.sealed_Huang_Hk: PASS_APPLIES and closes E3 family exactly by E4.
calibration.scope_note: C10 is not a generic CSP dichotomy theorem and applies only after exact factorization/upwardness is proved.

promotion_rule_update: Every later E2-uncovered candidate must test C1-C10 and any subsequent binding addendum before promotion.
firewalls: Visual similarity to monotone SAT/equality constraints is insufficient.
Upwardness without the exact unary x equality factorization is insufficient.
C10 does not imply a general connected-QALL carrier.
Failure of C10 is not hardness evidence.
